name: Eve Thermo (EU)

radios.note: CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth for Eve Thermo.

matter.note: CSA has several Eve Thermo entries (product IDs 0x007D and 0x004F at firmware 3.6.5, older ones at 3.5.x). Which matches the unit sold in the EU today was not confirmed.

apple_home.note: Eve says the first platform needs a hub with both Matter controller and Thread border router functions.

google_home.note: Eve lists Google Home. Eve says its on-device schedules need the Eve app, which is on Android for Google Home users.

alexa.note: Eve lists Alexa through Matter, with Echo devices as hubs. Eve says on-device schedules are not supported on Alexa.

smartthings.note: Eve lists Samsung SmartThings through Matter. Eve says on-device schedules are not supported on SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Eve page lists Eve Thermo as a Matter device. Some settings, such as offset calibration and child lock, are reportedly only in the Eve app.

hubRequired.note: No Eve bridge is needed, but Eve says you need a hub from your platform with Matter controller and Thread border router functions.

localControl.note: Eve says it works without subscriptions or a cloud dependency.

systems.value: M30 × 1.5 valves; Danfoss RA, RAV, RAVL adapters included
systems.note: Eve says it fits most radiators without an adapter. Non-M30 valves, such as Herz M28, need a third-party adapter. Adapter list is from a retailer listing; verify against Eve.

power.note: Reviews and retailers say 2 × AA, but no Eve page seen in search confirmed it.

summary: Eve Thermo is a radiator valve head that speaks Matter over Thread. It fits M30 × 1.5 mm valves, and Danfoss adapters come in the box. Eve lists Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant. It needs no cloud account, but each platform needs a hub with Matter and Thread border router support.
caveats: Needs a hub with Matter controller and Thread border router functions, such as a HomePod mini, Echo or Google Nest hub.
Eve says on-device schedules are not supported on Alexa or SmartThings and need the Eve app.
Eve Thermo Control, the room sensor, only works with Apple Home, per Eve.
Older Eve Thermo units need a Matter firmware update that requires an iPhone or iPad.
